column1: 任何|Use 任何 before a noun to mean any, often followed by 都 or 也. Usually do not insert 的.|任何人都可以来这里。|Anyone can come here.|有任何问题，都可以问我。|If you have any question, you can ask me.
要是……就……|要是 introduces a possible condition; 就 introduces its result.|要是明天下雨，我就在家。|If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.|要是你有时间，我们就一起学习。|If you have time, we will study together.

随着|随着 introduces a changing situation; the following clause describes a related change.|随着天气变冷，我穿的衣服越来越多。|As the weather becomes colder, I wear more clothes.|随着时间过去，我的中文越来越好。|As time passes, my Chinese gets better.

一方面……另一方面……|Use the two clauses to give two simultaneous reasons or aspects of a situation.|我一方面想工作，另一方面也想学习。|On one hand I want to work, and on the other I also want to study.|运动一方面让人健康，另一方面也让人快乐。|Exercise makes people healthy on one hand and happy on the other.
就是了|Add 就是了 after an action to reassure someone that the suggested action is all they need to do.|有问题，问老师就是了。|If you have a question, just ask the teacher.|想去，告诉我就是了。|If you want to go, just tell me.
……不过……|不过 introduces a limitation or contrast after an earlier statement.|这里很好，不过有点儿贵。|This place is good, but a little expensive.|我想去，不过没有时间。|I want to go, but I have no time.

并|并 can join closely related actions. Before 不 or 没有, it strengthens a denial of an assumption.|我看了材料，并告诉了老师。|I read the materials and told the teacher.|这个问题并不难。|This question is not actually difficult.

由于|由于 introduces a cause. It can begin a clause or precede a noun phrase; 所以 may introduce the result.|由于下雨，我们没有出去。|Because it was raining, we did not go out.|由于工作很忙，所以他没来。|Because work was busy, he did not come.
……是……不过……|Repeat an adjective or verb around 是 to concede a point, then give a reservation with 不过 or 就是.|好是好，不过太贵了。|It is good, but too expensive.|大是大，不过有点儿远。|It is large, but a little far away.

不仅……还……|不仅 or 不光 introduces one point, and 还 or 而且 adds a further point. Put 不仅 before the subject when the subjects differ.|他不仅会说中文，还会写汉字。|He speaks Chinese and also writes Chinese characters.|这里不仅方便，而且很安静。|This place is convenient and also quiet.

甚至|甚至 highlights an extreme or unexpected case beyond the preceding situation.|他很忙，甚至没有时间吃饭。|He is so busy he does not even have time to eat.|这里有很多商店，甚至还有学校。|There are many shops here, and even a school.
于是|于是 introduces a subsequent action or event that follows from the previous situation.|我饿了，于是去吃饭。|I was hungry, so I went to eat.|他没来，于是我给他打电话。|He did not come, so I called him.

动词 + 得 / 不了|Verb + 得了 expresses that an action is possible; verb + 不了 expresses that circumstances prevent it. 了 here is liǎo.|这些饭我吃得了。|I can finish this food.|东西太多，我拿不了。|There are too many things; I cannot carry them.
再说|再说 adds another reason supporting what was just said.|今天太晚了，再说我也累了。|It is too late today, and besides, I am tired.|别客气，再说我们是朋友。|No need to be so polite; besides, we are friends.
既……又 / 也……|既……又…… or 既……也…… links two qualities or facts that both apply.|这里既安静又干净。|This place is quiet and clean.|他既会说中文，也会写汉字。|He can speak Chinese and write Chinese characters.
来得及 / 来不及|来得及 means there is enough time; 来不及 means there is not enough time to do something.|现在出发，还来得及。|There is still enough time if we leave now.|我来不及吃早饭了。|I do not have time to eat breakfast.
至少|至少 sets a minimum amount, time or degree: at least.|我每天至少学习一个小时。|I study for at least an hour every day.|这里至少有十个人。|There are at least ten people here.
够|As a verb, 够 means enough. 够 + adjective + 的 emphasises a high degree, often with surprise.|这些钱够用了。|This money is enough.|这个房子够大的。|This home is really big.
各……各的|Repeating 各 stresses that each person carries out their own action separately.|我们各吃各的饭。|We each eat our own meal.|他们各做各的事。|They each do their own thing.
等|等 introduces the time or condition to wait for before carrying out the next action.|等他来了，我们再走。|We will leave after he arrives.|等水凉了再喝。|Wait until the water cools, then drink it.
厉害|厉害 can describe something severe or intense. After a verb plus 得, it shows a high degree.|他咳嗽得很厉害。|He is coughing badly.|我今天头疼得很厉害。|My head hurts badly today.

（没）有什么（好……）的|A rhetorical question such as 有什么好怕的 suggests there is no reason for the stated feeling or action.|有什么好怕的？|What is there to be afraid of?|朋友之间没有什么好客气的。|There is no need for formality between friends.
偶尔|偶尔 means occasionally and usually comes before the verb phrase.|我偶尔在外面吃饭。|I occasionally eat out.|他偶尔去学校看老师。|He occasionally visits his teacher at school.
……好……|In this pattern, 好 introduces the purpose of the preceding action: so as to or so that.|早点儿出发，好早点儿到。|Leave early so you can arrive early.|告诉我地址，好去找你。|Tell me the address so I can find you.
在……方面|在……方面 specifies the area or respect in which a statement applies.|在学习方面，他很认真。|He is serious about studying.|在工作方面，我还要多学习。|In work, I still need to learn more.
既然……就……|既然 presents an accepted fact, and 就 gives the conclusion or decision based on it.|既然下雨了，我们就在家吧。|Since it is raining, let's stay home.|既然有时间，就看看书吧。|Since you have time, read a book.
拿……来说|拿……来说 introduces an example to illustrate a general point.|拿这台电脑来说，它很方便。|Take this computer: it is convenient.|拿学习中文来说，每天都要练习。|Take learning Chinese: you need daily practice.
使|Subject + 使 + object + verb phrase states that something causes a person or thing to change or respond.|这件事使我很高兴。|This made me happy.|学习使我的中文越来越好。|Studying makes my Chinese better and better.

不管……都 / 也……|不管 introduces varying conditions; 都 or 也 states a result that stays the same in every case.|不管去哪儿，我都和你一起去。|Wherever you go, I will go with you.|不管工作多忙，都要休息。|However busy work is, you need to rest.

否则|否则 introduces the consequence if the preceding advice or condition is not followed.|早点儿出发，否则会迟到。|Leave early, otherwise you will be late.|要认真学习，否则很难通过考试。|Study seriously, otherwise passing the exam will be difficult.
跟……相比|跟……相比 sets a comparison reference before describing a difference.|跟以前相比，我现在更喜欢运动。|Compared with before, I like exercise more now.|跟昨天相比，今天热多了。|Compared with yesterday, today is much hotter.
有A有B|有A有B combines two related features into a compact description, such as 有山有水.|这里有山有水，我很喜欢。|This place has mountains and water; I like it.|他们有说有笑，非常高兴。|They are talking and laughing, very happily.
不……也……|This pattern says a result holds even without a particular action or condition.|你不说，我也知道。|Even if you do not say it, I know.|不看书，他也能回答。|He can answer even without looking at the book.
尽管……但是 / 可是……|尽管 concedes a fact; 但是 or 可是 introduces a contrasting outcome.|尽管下雨，但是我还想出去。|Although it is raining, I still want to go out.|尽管很累，可是他很高兴。|Although he is tired, he is happy.
此|此 means this, mainly in written expressions such as 此次 (this time) and 从此 (from then on).|此次活动很有意思。|This activity is interesting.|从此，我每天都学习中文。|From then on, I studied Chinese every day.
从来|从来 describes a situation across all past time. With negatives, 从来不 describes a habit and 从来没 describes experience.|我从来不迟到。|I am never late.|我从来没去过那里。|I have never been there.

说什么 / 怎么（着）也得|This spoken pattern expresses a firm necessity regardless of circumstances: whatever happens, must.|说什么也得早点儿回家。|Whatever happens, I must get home early.|今天怎么也得把作业做完。|No matter what, I must finish my homework today.
有的是|有的是 emphasises an abundant supply: there is plenty of something.|别着急，我们有的是时间。|Don't worry; we have plenty of time.|这里有的是好吃的东西。|There is plenty of delicious food here.

而|而 can contrast two clauses, link compatible descriptions, or connect a cause with an outcome. Unlike 和, it is not normally used just to join ordinary nouns.|我喜欢冬天，而他喜欢夏天。|I like winter, whereas he likes summer.|这里因为安静而吸引了很多人。|This place attracts many people because it is quiet.
再次|再次 means once again and normally appears before the verb phrase.|我再次来到了这座城市。|I came to this city again.|谢谢你再次帮助我。|Thank you for helping me again.
